review_text: "great wintertime hand moisturizer (or anytime, really) with fantastic ingredients and no fragrance! works very well to moisturize and sinks in quickly to leave no greasy feeling. my husband also uses this as his daily facial moisturizer and really likes it a lot."
"great product! i have very dry winter skin, and after a few days of using cetaphil, my skin feels so soft. highly recommend."
"this moisturizer is amazing! it really leaves my skin feeling soft and super hydrated, and you get a lot for the price too. can't go wrong with this purchase."

"amazing value, thick, moisturizing lotion that works on even the worst skin. once absorbed, it doesn’t leave a sticky feeling behind and it softens skin very well. it is very effective and a staple in our home. the price on amazon is unbeatable compared to purchasing in the store."

"i love this cream!it’s absolutely hydrating that provides your face with a little bit of a glow after using…someone with acne prone skin and using chemicals, this prevents your face from peeling…highly recommend and it’s worth every bit of the price…i will continue buying this cream for the rest of my life, that’s how good it is!need i say more?!!"

"cetaphil gets us through dry and itchy cold months. it was recommended by our dermatologist. while i have seen lower prices in local stores, the convenience of having it shipped to our doorstep is just what we need during the cold months."
"my face was so irritatingly dry and after just 1 use i noticed a difference! i used it before bed and woke up with beautiful skin! i do not usually leave reviews like this."
"this product really worksget it for the entire family you will never regret it"
"good value with the quantity . it’s a nice non greasy moisturizer ."

"the quantity is great. it's going to last more than a year for me. very thick, not oily and hydrating without causing break outs. i normally use light mosturizers to avoid acne but this has been great. i mainly use it when i use drying products like vitamin c or acids."
"i love this lotion. it works great all over my body  and it’s reasonable priced & my face feels soft -  my new go to ????"
"for dry skin there is nothing better  i can not live without this."
"love this brand and glad i got this container so i can take sure to get every last bit of lotion"
"i came across this product in desperation by reading the reviews and i was very impressed so i thought i would try it and haven’t been disappointed since."
"i use this stuff religiously everyday during the winter to keep my eczema at bay and after showers on my face and body, i like it cause it moisturizes and doesn't really have any smell"
"this works wonderful,  my husband is 87 yrs old  has paper like skin. cetaphil mends his skin like you would no believe. love it"
"good for travel. cream is thick and heavy"

"this cream is the literal best. my skin tends to be acne prone but yet dry and this is the only moisturizer that i have found that doesn’t make me break out while moisturizing. this size in particular is good because it can be thrown in a purse. if you have sensitive skin this is a great cream."

"cethaphil face and body moisturizer sits perfectly at the intersection of skin care efficacy and pure value for money. the cream goes on so well and absorbed by the skin so easily. no skin irritation nor redness post application. so good in fact this product could easily be a standalone face cream for those with sensitive or very dry skin."
"it's extremely moisturising! i love it!! my skin,used to be so dry and flaky too, butafter using this for what? 1 or 2 days my skin has improved a lot."
"good product for dry skin."
"best lotion for dry to extra dry skin. easier to use with wide open box packs"
"very good for dry skin"
"i found this cream to be just what is advertised."
"great moisturizer - feels good and moisturing skin protection"
"it works very well for dry face"

"the content inside the container was not creamy but seemed like precipitated. idk the best words to describe it and not sure if it's a damaged or normal.the temperature today in baltimore was warmer than previous day ( to say it was frozen) jan 7 2026"
"i love this product and i use it every day but  it is $2 to $4 more expensive on amazon than it is at target."
"cream is clumpy instead of smooth. i have been buying this for years and never seen this consistency. it seems to be ok but unusual"
"i could rub and get a little bit of cream , but i decided to refund , and purchase an aveno lotion ."
"i love the cream. i was super excited that they showed a flip lid. the original one i have has a screw on which isn’t preferred,  i revived ones with screw on lids so boooooooo"
"it's not the flip open cap anymore."
"ehh, so, so.. doesn't last too long after i put it on that's for sure,i thought i'd try this for 9 bucks on sale, cierra v is better in my opinion"

"i love this for the purpose of moisturizing. however, i don’t like the fact that it feels oily and sticky. when it dries, it seems to dry nice and the oily and stickiness goes away. it feels heavier than most moisturizers."
"these eye pads were mighty thin to work with!  they did lessen the bags but their delicate nature was frustrating!"
"i love it on my body and my neck, but i wouldn’t use it on my face. it’s way too greasy. promises to not clog pores but sure clogged mine."

"cetaphil is a five star  product that i have used for years.  what i received was a full container of white lotion, but the safety seal on the product was broken .  the odor and texture are similar to the cetaphil lotion i have, but i am not certain this is an authentic product."
"great cream make my skin smooth.when i get the product the top of it burst n everything run out in the box."

"before this last order, i would give cetaphil cream 5 stars, however, this time the product consistency was different.  it looks and feels fluffier, which causes you to have to use more.  hopefully, this is a fluke and cetaphil didn't change their quality for the worse."
"the jar come with out any seal on it the cream was very sweaty inside i don’t know if that’s how it supposed to be"

"moisturizes without making my face break out. keeps my skin soft i just wish it was less oily throughout the day. it doesn't seem to stop my dry skin but helps minimize it. smell isn't bad and doesn't last long."

"my favorite full body lotion. unscented and lightweight, which is nice year-round.just wish the bottle didn’t have the amazon sticker on top of it. would rather buy it in a store if it’s gonna come like that."
"my product came here and the cap was broken.  i need to send it back for a replacement,"
"in the amazon headline, it says "for face and body".  the instructions say it is for body. i have written to the mfg to find out the usage."
"this does not work for my skin i'm over 60 and it doesn't work for my five skin"
"left my face very greasy, even when using a small amount. it also made me break out."
"nice product price is good"
"of the 4 20oz jars, 2 were cracked open leaving complete content spillage in box and on other 2 jars. probably dropped on one side."
"good for face. but didn't like it for the rest of my body."
"this moisturizing cream is a great body cream, especially for hands.  found this 20 oz for great value.  i have been using for over 20  years.  great for elderly use and texture is smooth."
"i like the product, but the container "exploded" in the box on it's way to new zealand. i lost about 25% of the contents."

"i ordered a set of 12 items intended for carrying when outside the home. however, i received only one small box (1 oz) instead of the full set.i paid $36+ for what was clearly advertised as a 12-piece set, and receiving just 1 out of 12 items is unacceptable and misleading. this order does not match the product description."

"my face broke out in dry patches after using this product for a week.  the spots were red, dry and flaky.  i thought i was developing a rash or eczema until i remembered i had started using a new moisturizer. as soon as i discontinued it, my skin healed and it resolved.  do not recommend!!"
"i hate it.  they changed the formula.  i have used this moisturizer for 20 years.  it sucks now.  it is very heavy and thick and spongy due to the high glycerin content.  thumbs-down.terrible.  :-("

"i am not comfortable using the product i received. looks weird, has a rattle(in a jar of body cream is very suspicious?) and containers appear to have to seals already broken. i will be requesting a return and refund. not sure why cream has gaps around it in jar."

"when i opened the jar, the cream was clumpy. when i tried to mix it together it got clumpier and fell out of my hand in a few clumps. very disappointed. it look old and drying out….i bought 2.  i’m afraid to open the 2nd.."

"excellent product but not worth a 33% price hike! december 2024, i bought my usual 2 pack for $15.00. 7 months later the same 2 pack is $20! i've used cetaphil since i took accutane in 2018 but the product isn't that amazing. time to look for a cheaper item again to make up for yet another price increase. sigh."
"i have ordered this item twice now and it clearly states it is a pack of 12 both times i only received one little container of the lotion, not 12 so i have had to return this twice now"
"container was open and product got all over the items in the package"
"the moisturizer opened and it looks very old."

"i really wanted to like this brand because of the price. i have really sensitive skin and it’s hard to find good quality at a low price. this cream made my arms and face break out in tiny little bumps . i also bought the face wash and it’s just a big no"
"not actually cetaphil. this product was nothing like others i’ve purchased."
"i used this on my face and had the worse breakouts of my entire life. cystic acne all over my face. caused scarring. it was truly horrific. i have sensitive combination skin."

"says for use on face and body. ?????? do not use on your face if your skin is sensitive and/or acne prone. 2 days of using as directed and area of my face that don't usually break out are covered in small red pimples. only suitable for elbows, knees, or very dry hands."

"this product has a floral/rose-like scent, i assume from the phenoxyethanol -- it is not fragrance-free. further, it stings and burns the skin on my hands, which immediately reddened. this cream is most definitely not for sensitive skin! i hate this product and am tired of manufacturers touting the benefits of lotions and creams for sensitive skin, when all they do is cause further irritation."

"when i received my order, the two jars of cetaphil face & body moisturizer were dirty and the lid of one of the jars was loose and neither jar had a seal on the jars..i was very disappointed and i returned the order. also the box they came in was dirty as well."
"leaves a extremely greasy texture on the skin"

"did cetaphil changed the product formula? i opened the product as soon as i received, and the cream doesn’t have the same product consistency as when used to buy the packaged at costco. cream feels to have much more air in to it and it lost its paste consistency"
"seal was broken. there is a video of a girl shaking the product out of it's canister and that's exactly what i got. this seems like a makeshift product.this cound be anything and doesn't seem safe."
"unfortunately the lid is completely cracked on the item up on arrival."
"they have recently reformulated within the last couple of years. i loved this product before it contained niacinamide."
"these did not have the inner seal. the lotion was also congealed. practically solid."
"i’m sorry this didn’t work out.  it showed up with the top off and feels like it was used (or returned) previously. notice even the phone cords are in packaging.  something is off here."
"it arrived cracked and leaking. half the product is the envelope it was delivered in. can’t really trust using it and can’t exact send it back so just a $10 loss honestly."
